name: EIA Form 860 Generator Data
known_limitations: Early-release and proposed-generator fields are preliminary; proposed capacity is not a utility commitment, completed construction, interconnection, or operating capacity.
automation_notes: Preserve reporting year, release status, plant and generator identifiers, operating status, capacity units, energy source, and in-service date.
notes: Generator-level inventory rail for operable, proposed, retired, and canceled capacity.
